info.title: Delta Registry — GrantConnect grants.gov.au - Grant Awards Delta Feed
info.description: Monitor every Australian Government grant award on GrantConnect (grants.gov.au): recipient, ABN, agency, value, purpose, program and location. Server-side filters (keyword, category, ABN, value, dates), delta mode flags new, varied and updated awards, ISO dates, numeric AUD. Pay per result.

post.summary: Start an async run of: Monitor every Australian Government grant award on GrantConnect (grants.gov.au): recipient, ABN, agency, value, purpose, program and location. Server-side filters (keyword, category, ABN, value, dates), delta mode flags new, varied and updated awards, ISO dates, numeric AUD. Pay per result.
post.x-async-pattern-reason: No production run history exists for this actor — defaulting to the async run+poll pattern as a precaution, not a measurement. Re-run this generator once real telemetry exists to potentially switch it to sync.

keyword.description: Full-text search over grant title, purpose and activity (also accepts a GA ID such as GA578886). Matching mode below.

categories.description: GrantConnect's 29 top-level categories. Select several to get their union. The record's own 'category' field shows the finer sub-category label (e.g. 'Medical Research').

agencyNameContains.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the awarding agency, e.g. 'Health' or 'Infrastructure'. Applied client-side (GrantConnect's public form has no agency parameter), so combine it with a category, keyword or date window to keep the walk short.

recipientName.description: Substring match on the recipient's legal name, e.g. 'Monash University' or 'Regional Express'.

recipientAbn.description: Exact match on the recipient's 11-digit Australian Business Number (spaces optional). Returns every Commonwealth grant that entity has received.

minValueAud.description: Only awards worth at least this amount. Tip: 1000000 narrows the 360,000-record register to roughly 28,000.

maxValueAud.description: Only awards worth at most this amount.

goId.description: All awards made under one Grant Opportunity (funding round), e.g. GO6105.

dateType.description: Which date the 'from'/'to' window applies to. 'Current' = grants running today and 'Closed' = grants whose term has ended (both ignore the window).

dateFrom.description: Absolute (2026-07-01) or relative ('7 days', '3 months', '1 year' back from today, Canberra time). Leave empty for the whole archive (December 2017 onwards).

dateTo.description: Absolute or relative upper bound of the window. Leave empty for 'today'.

oneOffAdHoc.description: Ad hoc grants (no competitive round) are the ones probity and integrity teams watch most closely.

aggregateGrantAward.description: Aggregate awards bundle several recipients into one record ('Multiple').

eventTypes.description: NEW_LISTING = a brand-new award; AWARD_VARIATION = a variation/amendment record (value or term changed, e.g. GA270901-V1); UPDATED = an award you already received whose 'Last Updated' stamp moved (delta mode only).

onlyNew.description: Remembers every award it has delivered (per filter set, in a named key-value store) and returns only awards that are new, varied or updated since. The walk stops as soon as it reaches already-known records, so a scheduled run costs a few pages instead of the whole register.

sortBy.description: 'Last updated' (recommended, and required for reliable monitoring): variations and corrections of old awards keep their original publish date, so only this order surfaces them. 'Relevance' needs a keyword.

deltaStateName.description: Optional label for the memory of a monitoring task. Defaults to a fingerprint of your filters, so different schedules never interfere. Set the same name on two tasks to make them share one memory.

resetState.description: Forget every previously delivered award for this delta state and re-baseline (the run then returns up to 'Max records' most recently updated awards).

maxItems.description: Hard cap on delivered records (and therefore on cost: you pay per record). In delta mode anything beyond the cap is simply delivered by the next run.

fetchDetail.description: Opens each award's page (one extra request) for recipient ABN and location, delivery location, purpose, program, Grant Opportunity link, selection process, confidentiality flags and the agency contact. Off = listing-only summary records (cheaper 'result-summary' price).

maxConcurrency.description: How many award pages are fetched at once. GrantConnect tolerates 10 comfortably; 5 keeps a 500-record run under two minutes.

dateRange.description: Kept for tasks created with version 1: '24h', '7d' or '30d' are interpreted as 'Date from'.

201.description: Run started. Poll GET /actor-runs/{runId} with the returned run id until status is SUCCEEDED, then fetch its dataset items.

get.summary: Poll the status of a previously started run.

200.description: Current run status. When status is SUCCEEDED, fetch the dataset via GET /datasets/{datasetId}/items, passing this response's defaultDatasetId field as {datasetId}.

get.summary: Fetch the dataset items produced by a completed run.

200.description: Array of normalized records from the actor run.

items.title: GrantConnect Grant Awards
items.description: One item per Grant Award record from GrantConnect (grants.gov.au). Raw site strings are kept verbatim next to normalised siblings (ISO dates, numeric AUD, 11-digit ABN) so the data drops straight into a warehouse, CRM or spreadsheet. Records are appended oldest-first within a run; read newest-first with ?desc=true.

record_id.title: Record ID
record_id.description: Same value as gaId - stable across runs (e.g. GA578886, GA270901-V1 for a variation).

event_type.title: Event type
event_type.description: NEW_LISTING, AWARD_VARIATION or UPDATED (a previously delivered award whose Last Updated stamp moved).

scraped_at.title: Scraped at
scraped_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of this extraction.

is_new.title: Is new
is_new.description: true when this award was never delivered by a previous run of this delta state.

gaUuid.title: GA UUID
gaUuid.description: Stable identifier from the record URL.

baseGaId.title: Base GA ID
baseGaId.description: The original award this record belongs to (equals gaId for a base award).

title.title: Title
title.description: Grant Activity title as shown on the listing.

agency.title: Agency
agency.description: Awarding agency name as recorded at publication.

lastUpdatedIso.title: Last updated
lastUpdatedIso.description: UTC ISO-8601 instant converted from Canberra local time - the register's only time-of-day field and the delta engine's change key.

valueAudNumber.title: Value AUD
valueAudNumber.description: Numeric value for sorting, summing and thresholds.

daysUntilGrantEnd.title: Days until grant end
daysUntilGrantEnd.description: Negative once the term has ended - a renewal/re-tender signal.

isCurrent.title: Is current
isCurrent.description: true while today falls inside the grant term.

recipientEntityType.title: Recipient entity type
recipientEntityType.description: company, local_government, university, aboriginal_corporation, incorporated_association, trust, government, multiple or other - derived from the legal name.

detailFetched.title: Detail fetched
detailFetched.description: false when fetchDetail was off or the award page could not be retrieved (see detailError).

agencyCurrentName.title: Agency (current name)
agencyCurrentName.description: Agency name on the award page - reflects machinery-of-government renames.

gstInclusive.title: GST inclusive
gstInclusive.description: true when the award page marks the value 'GST inclusive where applicable'.

goId.title: GO ID
goId.description: The originating Grant Opportunity (funding round), when linked.

recipientAbnNormalized.title: Recipient ABN
recipientAbnNormalized.description: 11 digits, no spaces - the join key for ABR, ASIC, CRM and credit data.

deliveryPostcode.title: Delivery postcode
deliveryPostcode.description: Where the grant is delivered - can differ from the recipient's address (e.g. 'Multiple').

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Newest activity first: who got what, from which agency, for how much.

recipients.title: Recipient directory
recipients.description: Entity-resolution view: ABN-keyed recipients with location and the ABR lookup link.

programs.title: Programs & opportunities
programs.description: Ties each award back to its funding round, program and selection process.

terms.title: Grant terms & expiry
terms.description: Renewal pipeline: start, end, days remaining and financial year.

variations.title: Variations & updates
variations.description: Amendments to earlier awards (value or term changes) and updates to known records.
